name: Pre-Order Timer
author: ACME Scripts

sections.description:
Pre-Order Timer extends WooCommerce to allow store owners to set up pre-order products with countdown timers. The plugin provides multiple display styles, customizable messages, and flexible expiry handling options.

Join the Pre-Order Timer Pro Waitlist Today & Get 30% Off

Features

  • Pre-order Product Support: Enable pre-orders for any WooCommerce product
  • Multiple Countdown Styles: Choose from text-only, progress bar, or modern style countdowns
  • Customizable Messages: Set custom countdown text and expiry messages
  • Flexible Expiry Handling: Choose what happens when pre-orders expire
  • WooCommerce Integration: Seamlessly integrates with existing WooCommerce functionality
  • Responsive Design: Works on all devices and themes

Interested in more features? Join the Pro waitlist & Get 30% Off

Countdown Styles

  • Text Only: Simple text-based countdown
  • Progress Bar: Visual progress bar showing time remaining
  • Modern Style: Attractive modern countdown with animations

Expiry Options

  • Hide Timer: Remove countdown when expired
  • Show Message: Display custom expiry message
  • Hide Cart Button: Disable purchasing for expired pre-orders

Upgrade coming soon – join the Pro waitlist to get 30% off

Easy Setup

  1. Install and activate the plugin
  2. Go to WooCommerce > Settings > Products > Pre-Order Settings
  3. Enable pre-order functionality
  4. Configure your preferred settings
  5. Edit products to enable pre-orders and set end dates
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/preorder-timer directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress admin interface.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to WooCommerce > Settings > Products > Pre-Order Settings to configure the plugin.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin work with all WooCommerce themes?

Yes, the plugin is designed to work with all WooCommerce-compatible themes.

Can I customize the countdown appearance?

Yes, you can choose from three different countdown styles and customize the text messages.

What happens when a pre-order expires?

You can configure this in the settings. Options include hiding the timer, showing an expiry message, or hiding the add to cart button.

Is this plugin compatible with WooCommerce 8.0?

Yes, the plugin has been tested with WooCommerce 8.0 and is fully compatible.
